items.prompt:
Read.

She slammed her locker, ignored her friends, and ate alone.

We can infer she is:
A) cheerful
B) upset
C) hungry

steps: Actions show distress. Key is B.

items.prompt:
An inference is a conclusion supported by:
A) a guess
B) evidence and reasoning
C) the title

To support an analysis well, you should cite:
A) one detail only
B) several pieces of evidence
C) no evidence

Read.

Deven arrived early, reread his notes twice, yet his hands shook at the podium.

Which inference is BEST supported?
A) Deven didn't care
B) Deven was anxious but well prepared
C) Deven was asleep
items.answer: B) Deven was anxious but well prepared

steps: Early + notes + shaking. Key is B.
solution.answer: B) Deven was anxious but well prepared

items.prompt:
Read.

'I'm fine,' Mara said, but she pushed her untouched plate away and stared at the floor.

The text suggests Mara is:
A) truly fine
B) upset despite her words
C) excited

steps: Actions contradict words. Key is B.

items.prompt:
Why cite MORE than one piece of evidence?
A) to make the analysis more convincing
B) to fill space
C) to confuse the reader
items.answer: A) to make the analysis more convincing

steps: Several details build a case. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) to make the analysis more convincing

items.prompt:
Read.

He counted his coins twice, glanced at the price tag, then quietly set the model ship back on the shelf and left.

The BEST supported inference is that he:
A) didn't like the ship
B) couldn't afford the ship
C) already owned the ship

steps: Counting coins + checking price + leaving it. Key is B.

items.prompt:
Which choice uses SEVERAL pieces of evidence to support an inference?
A) 'She was kind because she smiled.'
B) 'She was kind: she shared her lunch, helped a lost child, and stayed late to tutor a classmate.'
C) 'She seemed nice.'
items.answer: B) 'She was kind: she shared her lunch, helped a lost child, and stayed late to tutor a classmate.'

solution.answer: B) 'She was kind: she shared her lunch, helped a lost child, and stayed late to tutor a classmate.'
